column4: Kasumigaseki Properties Development respects the privacy of website visitors, buyers, investors, partners and people who contact us through forms, email or events. This policy explains what we collect, why we collect it and the choices you have.
This policy applies to personal information collected through this website and through the ways people reach us from it.
People enquiring about a development or an investment.
Brokers and project partners we work with.
We may collect the following, depending on how you deal with us.
Your name, email address and phone number.
Enquiry form, floor plan requests, email
The development you're interested in, and whether you want a call, a visit to our Customer Experience Center, to invest or to partner as a broker.
Your details when you register for a KPD event.
Subscribe form in the site footer
Basic information about how the website is used.
We use the information above to:
We do not sell personal information.

We may share information with the groups below, but only where needed to respond to a request or operate the website. We may also disclose information where required by law, a court order or a government authority.
Companies that help us operate the website.
Professionals who help us respond to your request.
Partners involved in a project you've enquired about.

Some of our service providers may use cloud-based tools, so information may be processed in countries outside the United Arab Emirates. Where this happens, we expect the provider to protect it in line with applicable law.
We keep personal information only for as long as it is needed for the purposes described in this policy, or as the law requires.
We use reasonable organisational and technical measures to protect the information we hold. No method of transmission over the internet is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.
You may request access to your information, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it. You can also stop receiving project updates at any time. To do any of these, contact us at info@kpd.ae.

This website is not intended for children, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from them. If you believe a child has sent us information, please contact us and we will take appropriate steps to remove it.
We may update this policy by posting a revised version on this page. Your continued use of the website after a change means you accept the revised policy.

column4: This section explains how the Kasumigaseki Properties Development website uses cookies and similar technologies, and how you can control them.
Cookies are small text files that a website stores on your device. They help a site work properly, remember your choices and understand how it is used.

We use cookies to keep the website running, to remember information you have entered, and to understand how visitors use the site so we can improve it. In most cases there is no way to switch off a cookie without also switching off the feature it supports.
Keeps the website working, for example page navigation and form submission.
Remembers choices you make, such as details entered on a form.
Helps us understand how visitors use the website, using aggregated usage data.
Some cookies are set by third-party services we use, such as analytics tools or embedded content. These providers have their own privacy policies, which govern how they use that information.
You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings. Please note that turning them off may affect how parts of the website work.
